CONVERSATION.NAME: Survive Claire's Attack
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP:
Claire has something against Melissa and you're just an innocent bystander. Try to survive the barrage.
CONFIDENT: Maintain your confidence.
HAPPY: Don't let Claire bring your down.

CARD.NAME: Blissfully Ignorant.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You have no idea why Claire is going off. It's hard to take it seriously. Gives a bonus to all happy dialog.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of happy,

CARD.NAME: Good day.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You know, I was having a pretty good day before you came in here acting like a freak.

CARD.NAME: Have you considered therapy?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Do you always pick fights with people you don't even know? I think you need a shrink.

CARD.NAME: Helpful.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Melissa is one of the few people who actually seems to want to help in this town.

CARD.NAME: If you hate Melissa...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If a bitch like you hates her, Claire, Melissa must be worth being friends with.

CARD.NAME: Not impressed.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Your yipping at me is about as impressive as that chihuahua you carry around.

CARD.NAME: Not my business.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: What's going on? This has got nothing to do with me.

CARD.NAME: She seems nice.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Melissa has been really nice to me since I got here.

CARD.NAME: This isn't about me.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Shouldn't you be screaming at Melissa?

CARD.NAME: You don't know me
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You've got a lot of nerve talking to me like this.

CARD.NAME: Biting Words
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Claire's words shake your confidence.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: Charity box much?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You know you're supposed to put crappy clothing INTO those metal boxes in front of the supermarket, not pull it out.

CARD.NAME: Clueless.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You really have no idea what's going on, do you? Pathetic.

CARD.NAME: Hopeless.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Claire is holding all the cards, she knows just what to say to cut you and Melissa down.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -2 to all my cards of happy,

CARD.NAME: Poor judgement.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Hanging out with Melissa, new girl? It's the blind leading the stupid.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: A matchmaker with experience.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Melissa helping you find a boyfriend? She's got a lot of experience with each and every guy in town. "First hand" experience.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Poor Melissa.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Has Melissa asked to borrow money yet? Or is she still hitting up her dad for pocket change?

CARD.NAME: Rumor: You're with stupid.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Melissa seriously forgot her own birthday last year.

CARD.NAME: Secret: New drunk in town.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You Melissa's new drinking buddy, new girl? Hoping to take over her job as town drunk?

CARD.NAME: Stay out of it.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You should mind your own business, new girl.
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -2 to all my cards of happy,
